title: Deliverance of Israel

questions.question: In that day the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:1 (ESV): "In that day the LORD... will punish Leviathan"

questions.question: Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan the twisting serpent, and he will slay the dragon that is in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:1 (ESV): "and he will slay the dragon that is in the sea."

questions.question: In that day, a pleasant what, sing of it!
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:2 (ESV): "In that day, a pleasant vineyard, sing of it!"

questions.question: I, the LORD, am its keeper; every moment I do what to it?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:3 (ESV): "every moment I water it." (ESV text: "I, the LORD, am its keeper; every moment I water it.")

questions.question: In days to come Jacob shall take root, Israel shall blossom and put forth shoots and fill the whole world with what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:6 (ESV): "and fill the whole world with fruit."

questions.question: Or let them lay hold of my protection, let them make peace with whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:5 (ESV): "let them make peace with me."

questions.question: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or have they been slain as their slayers were what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:7 (ESV): "Or have they been slain as their slayers were slain?"

questions.question: Measure by measure, by exile you contended with them; he removed them with his fierce breath in the day of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:8 (ESV): "in the day of the east wind."

questions.question: Therefore by this the guilt of Jacob will be atoned for, and this will be the full fruit of the removal of his what?
When he makes all the stones of the altars like chalkstones crushed to pieces, no Asherim or incense altars will remain what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:9 (ESV): "no Asherim or incense altars will remain standing."

questions.question: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the what?
When its boughs are dry, they are broken; women come and make a what of them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:11 (ESV): "women come and make a fire of them."

questions.question: For this is a people without discernment; therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them; he who formed them will show them no what?
In that day from the river Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt the LORD will thresh out the grain, and you will be gleaned one by one, O people of whom?

And in that day a great trumpet will be blown, and those who were lost in the land of Assyria and those who were driven out to the land of Egypt will come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain at where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 27:13 (ESV): "on the holy mountain at Jerusalem."

key_verse_text: In days to come Jacob shall take root, Israel shall blossom and put forth shoots and fill the whole world with fruit.
